result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`. The change is six lines, all in the two methods you named. Nothing is committed.

- **Gradle JS (`addBuildAndDeploymentConventions`):** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `build.gradle` still matches the existing `.gradle` rule.
- **`.htm` pages (`addGeneratedConventions`):** the three HTML rules (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator) now use `(html|htm|xhtml)`. The duplicated `html` was a typo, and `htm` was the missing extension.
- **JS and .NET XML (`addGeneratedConventions`):** `.*/[.]js` is now `.*[.]js`, and `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*[.]xml`. These match `app.js` and `MyAssembly.xml`, and the existing content checks (`// Generated by …`, `<doc>` line) still decide whether a file is generated.

Verification: `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest=SourceFileFilterTest,SourceCodeFilesTest` passed with no output. I did not add a new test. I also tried a standalone regex check of the cases you listed, but the sandbox refused that command, so the new patterns are verified only by reading them. The one case worth a spot check is `.*[.]xml`, which now also reaches XML files in any directory. The `<doc>` content check still limits it to .NET documentation files.
